summary.text: Gary Click is a Republican state representative and pastor from Vickery who has represented Ohio House District 88 since January 1, 2021, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He chairs the House Community Revitalization Committee.

paragraphs.text: Click earned a bachelor's degree in religious education from Midwestern Baptist College in 1990.
His career experience includes serving as pastor of Fremont Baptist Temple.
Click succeeded Bill Reineke in District 88 and defeated Democrat Dianne Selvey in the November 5, 2024 general election.
Ballotpedia lists his committees as Children and Human Services, Community Revitalization (chair), Education, and Ways and Means.
Aaron Jones is the Democratic candidate in the 2026 general election.
